#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
    return __builtin_add_overflow(a, b, out);
#else
    if ((b > 0 && a > INT64_MAX - b) || (b < 0 && a < INT64_MIN - b)) {
        return 1;
    }
    *out = a + b;
    return 0;
#endif
}
